title: QA: Lair in its own scene
eyebrow: Hand test for issue #536 (the Lair and the Market in their own scene) and its steps, issues #537 to #543, #549 and #550

qa.feature: The Lair and the Market in their own scene
unverified: Nobody has played the new flow by hand yet.
The loading screen was seen in a solo run; in co-op it was not photographed on the client.
Extracting loot and finding it on the pile was checked solo, not in co-op.
The Market yard was not walked through after the split; only the Lair room was looked at.

short.lead: The game now runs on three scenes. Bootstrap is never unloaded. It holds the network, the players, the campaign and the raid director. The Lair scene holds the Lair room and the Market. The raid scene holds the castle. Only one of the Lair and the raid is loaded at a time, behind a loading screen, and each player's screen stays up until their own castle is built. In a co-op run, both machines built the same castle (63 rooms, 246 breakable parts). After returning, both had 0 rooms, 0 parts and 0 debris effects left. The editor tests pass. You still need to play the steps below by hand.
short.hint: Start co-op with the command in the first item, "Open the game in co-op". Then play the items in order. Each one says what you should see.
items: In Git Bash, from C:\Users\aj\Desktop\GameDev\PlunderSpell-demand, run: bash Tools/Unity/coop_local.sh. It rebuilds the client if the game changed, presses Play in the Editor (which now starts in the Bootstrap scene), hosts, and opens a second window that joins. You should see "Co-op on this PC is up" and two windows side by side, both in the Lair.
Run it once; every item below follows from it.
The Lair looks as it did

The Lair scene now has its own moon and night atmosphere. Without them it was flat and grey. Walk the Lair and the Market in both windows. You should see the warm night look, the ledger, the dial, the haul pile and the counters, all as before.
Say if anything is missing or lit wrongly.
Step into the portal. Both windows should show the Loading card, then arrive in the castle with it already built; no castle should appear around you after you arrive.
Tell me how long the card stayed up, and whether any part of the castle popped in after you arrived.

Die in one run and extract in another, and go back to the Lair each time. You should see the Loading card again, then the Lair, with no part of the castle anywhere. On the extract run, carry a piece out first, then look for it on the haul pile.
Tell me if any part of the raid was left behind, or if the piece is missing from the haul pile.
Behind the Loading card, a fresh castle should be built, different from the first one.
Tell me if the second castle looks like leftovers from the first raid.

changes: Bootstrap, Lair and RaidScene, listed first in the build, in that order.
Bootstrap never unloaded; Lair or raid on top, one at a time
A full-screen Loading card on every machine while a scene changes.
Stays up until that machine's castle is built, or until it is back in the Lair

A raid scene of its own, entered through the Lair.
A copy of the whole game scene
A raid scene of its own, loaded in place of RaidScene when you run coop_local.sh with --gym

wrapup.summary: The split is built and pushed on the branch AjsAgent/gym-with-demand-page. Nobody has played it by hand yet.

wrapup.blocking: Your hand test. Issues #536 to #543, #549 and #550 stay marked "needs review" until it passes.
